SQL: استعلام.text:
```sql
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;
```

SQL: استعلام.text:
Here is the SQL query you need:

```sql
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) as total_orders
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 1000
ORDER BY total_orders DESC;
```
This query will return the names of customers along with their total orders from the 'customers' table and only those who have ordered more than 1000 items, sorted in descending order by the number of orders.

Here is a Python solution using the `send2whatsapp` library:

```python
import json
from send2whatsapp import send2whatsapp

# Define your action as a dictionary
action = {
    "name": "<اسم الأداة>", 
    "arguments": {"<مفتاح>": "<قيمة>"}}

# Convert the dictionary to JSON format
json_string = json.dumps(action)

send2whatsapp('966501234567', 'طلبك في الطريق: {}'.format(json_string))
```

This script will send a message to the WhatsApp number `966501234567` with the text `"Your request goes here"`, where "Your request goes here" is replaced by the JSON string representation of your action. 

Please note that you need to have the `send2whatsapp` library installed (`pip install send2whatsapp`) and also replace '<اسم الأداة>' and '{<مفتاح>}' with actual values as per your requirements.
